name: NanJi E-Commerce Co., LTD
summary: NanJi E-Commerce Co., LTD provides comprehensive brand, distributor brand authorization, and mobile internet marketing services in China and internationally. It offers underwear, bedding, menswear, women's wear, children's wear, maternal and infant wear, and healthy living products under the Nanjiren, Cartelo Crocodile, Jingdian Teddy, Nanji Youxuan, Antartic, Antartic+, Antartic home, and Classic Teddy brands; and industry chain services, such as resource integration, data empowerment, research and development, design, quality management, and traffic management.
